rules.statement: Map workflows involving personal data to applicable obligations under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection framework and organization policy before deployment.
Apply security, transparency, accountability, and responsible-use controls consistent with current Indonesian AI ethics guidance and later superseding instruments.
Distinguish enacted law, binding regulation, advisory guidance, draft instruments, and public policy statements.
Do not present a draft RPerpres or announced policy as enacted law unless an official source confirms establishment.
Apply sector-specific Indonesian rules in addition to this baseline for healthcare, finance, public services, employment, or other regulated activity.
